httpCalls.test:
Regression: a broken route handler must not wedge navigation.

   Playwright runs route handlers on its own dispatch thread and swallows the
   exception. An intercepted request that is never resumed, aborted or fulfilled
   hangs the navigation FOREVER — no timeout, no log line — which is how a single
   `(fn [route _] ...)` wedged whole daemon sessions until the command budget
   killed them. `route!` now guards the handler and resumes the route. > a handler that throws > is released and navigation completes
httpCalls.name: 200 GET http://localhost:39657/health

Regression: a broken route handler must not wedge navigation.

   Playwright runs route handlers on its own dispatch thread and swallows the
   exception. An intercepted request that is never resumed, aborted or fulfilled
   hangs the navigation FOREVER — no timeout, no log line — which is how a single
   `(fn [route _] ...)` wedged whole daemon sessions until the command budget
   killed them. `route!` now guards the handler and resumes the route. > a well-formed handler still routes > runs the handler and lets it answer the request

logs.test:
Regression: a broken route handler must not wedge navigation.

   Playwright runs route handlers on its own dispatch thread and swallows the
   exception. An intercepted request that is never resumed, aborted or fulfilled
   hangs the navigation FOREVER — no timeout, no log line — which is how a single
   `(fn [route _] ...)` wedged whole daemon sessions until the command budget
   killed them. `route!` now guards the handler and resumes the route. > a handler that throws > is released and navigation completes
logs.name: Full stderr log
